task.description:
Fix review finding R2 of step 11. In tools/src/picker/public/app.js, changeLanguage(): a language change begun on the result screen must be dropped when the visitor left that screen before the answer came (decisions/0078 item 11; design rule L4 in docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md). Today the screen guard exists only inside the same-version result branch. When the questionnaire answer arrives with another version (newVersion) or as a failure (langFailed) after the visitor pressed Back or Start again, the page wrongly shows the card with the notice (rewrites storage) or a connection block for an abandoned change.

Fix: right after the stale-ticket check (ticket !== state.ticket) add the guard: if the change began on the result screen (from === "result") and the screen is no longer the result, return — before the failure branch and before the new-version branch. Nothing else changes: no new state, no new text. Keep the guard that already exists after postResult. Update the comment above changeLanguage only if it becomes untrue.

Rules: change only tools/src/picker/public/app.js. Do not edit tests (the next step writes the test). Do not use git checkout, reset, stash or clean; make no commits. Run npm run check once at the end from tools/ (nothing in parallel; the computer has 16 GB RAM). Expected: zero red. Report the numbers honestly. No machine paths and no other projects' names in the handoff text.

result.summary: Closed finding R2 of step 11. In changeLanguage() of tools/src/picker/public/app.js one guard line was added right after the stale-ticket check: a language change begun on the result screen (from === "result") is dropped when the screen is no longer the result, before the failure branch (langFailed) and before the new-version branch (newVersion). So an answer that comes with another version, or as a failure, after the visitor pressed Back or Start over no longer opens the card with the notice, no longer rewrites the storage and no longer shows a connection block for an abandoned change (decisions/0078 item 11, design rule L4). Nothing else changed: no new state, no new text; the guard after postResult stays; the comment above changeLanguage is still true (it already says that a press whose answer comes after the visitor left the screen of the result is dropped), so it is not changed. No test touched (the next step writes the test).
changes: R2 - tools/src/picker/public/app.js, function changeLanguage(), new line 516 right after 'if (ticket !== state.ticket) return;': 'if (from === "result" && state.screen !== "result") return;'. It stands before 'if (outcome.kind !== "ok") { langFailed(...) }' and before 'if (body.version !== state.q.version) { newVersion(body) }', so both late paths (failed answer, answer with another version) are dropped when the change began on the result screen and the visitor has left it. A change begun on another screen is not affected (from !== "result").
